description.value: SunTea Canada is a BC-founded bubble tea chain (est. 2019) serving fresh-brewed fruit teas and milk teas, now operating 13 stores across British Columbia and Alberta. This Lougheed Highway location sits in a Burnaby shopping complex and offers online pickup ordering and a loyalty rewards app. For a touring cyclist, it is a convenient stop for a cold or hot tea drink on routes through the Burnaby–Coquitlam corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active SunTea Canada chain location (fresh-brewed bubble tea, founded 2019) with online ordering and a rewards program. The website's store list identifies the address '#115-4112 Lougheed Hwy' as 'SunTea Gilmore Burnaby', meaning the OSM community tag 'North Vancouver' is incorrect — there is a separate 'SunTea North Van' at 1595 Marine Dr. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website. Takeout is confirmed by the prominent 'Order Pickup' online ordering system.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'North Vancouver' but the website store list identifies this address (#115-4112 Lougheed Hwy) as 'SunTea Gilmore Burnaby' — address city corrected to Burnaby. A separate 'SunTea North Van' exists at 1595 Marine Dr, North Vancouver; the two locations may have been confused.
OSM name is 'Sun Tea' (two words) but the business consistently uses 'SunTea' (one word) on its website and in all store listings.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active chain location confirmed by website store listing; useful to cyclists as a refreshment stop on the Burnaby–Coquitlam corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: No phone number present in OSM or on the website; contact is by email at info@sunteabc.com.
